why: issue 1942 — rclrs's `ServiceInfo` has no such method because its fields are not optional. Ours are (see `rust:ServiceInfo`), and this answers "did the backend report ANYTHING for this request" in one call: false on a backend with no per-request metadata (every C-ABI backend today, issue 2081), which a reader must not confuse with any particular field value. The Rust spelling of `cpp:MessageInfo::is_reported`.
